_comment: Operator-editable mission defaults. Loaded by main.py via --config (default path: this file). Override individual fields freely; unknown fields are ignored. To use the GA-tuned weights from outputs/ga/best_params.json instead, pass --use-ga (or --params PATH).
_comment_line_command_map: IR code -> [left_duty, right_duty]. Vendor map used +/-4000 for hard turns and that overcorrects on the real chassis (one-tick 60-90deg rotation). Tunings here are conservative: every code keeps both wheels at >=400 forward duty so the chassis always advances along the line and never pivots in place mid-track. Tweak here without touching code.
_comment_line_steer_limit: Max change in either wheel duty per tick. Smooths bang-bang transitions so a single noisy IR flip cannot slam the chassis perpendicular to the line. Set above the line crawl speed so the first tick after a stop snaps to the centered (1100, 1100) command immediately.
_comment_carry_obstacle: After a successful pickup the ultrasonic still sees the held ball at ~5-10cm. Suppress obstacle detection for `carry_obstacle_grace_s` after pickup completes, and treat anything closer than `carry_min_obstacle_cm` as the ball itself (not an obstacle).
